# Chaplins Barbers

> Traditional barber shop on Chatham Hill Road, Sevenoaks. Established as a brand in 1889, the year Charles Chaplin was born. Skin fades, scissor cuts, hot towel shaves. Booked via WhatsApp. Walk-ins welcome when the chair is free.

## Location

Chatham Hill Road, Greatness, Sevenoaks, Kent, TN14 5AP, United Kingdom.

## Hours

Tuesday to Friday: 9:00 to 18:00. Saturday: 8:30 to 17:00. Closed Sunday and Monday.

## Services and prices

Haircut £19. Cut, wash and blow dry £23. Clipper cut £15. Skin fade £21. Kids cut (under 12) £14. Kids cut, wash and blow dry £17. Seniors haircut £15. Seniors cut, wash and blow dry £18. Beard trim £9. Beard trim and shape £12. Luxury hot towel shave £15. Hairline shape-up £8. Threading £6. Face mask £8. Nose wax and ear flame £4.

## Booking

WhatsApp: 07383 449899. Walk-ins accepted when the chair is free. Most cuts take about thirty minutes.

## What this place is

A barber shop, not a salon. The cut is the work — no styling consultations, no upselling. The toddler chair is the chair parents tell each other about. Sound of Chaplins plays in the background, picked daily.
